articles.title: ‘If you don’t shower, so what?’ The western diplomats staying put in under-attack Kyiv
articles.summary:
Ambassadors say presence sends powerful signal of solidarity and support amid escalation in Russian strikes and warnings

The warning from Moscow was blunt. Western diplomats should immediately leave the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv. If they failed to do so they would be “in mortal danger”. The statement added that Russia would not responsible for any “potential negative consequences” if its advice was ignored.

European envoys in Kyiv responded to the Kremlin’s threat last month with a loud raspberry. Denmark’s ambassador to Ukraine, Thomas Lund-Sørensen, took to social media to say that he was staying. So did the ambassadors from Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, France, Poland and Estonia. Even the Americans indicated they would not be budging.

articles.title: Reclaiming Mary Cassatt: putting overlooked American artist back at heart of impressionism
articles.summary:
New exhibition restores painter’s place as leading figure in French movement that revolutionised art

As a painter, friend, and collaborator of Edgar Degas, who exhibited with impressionist artists including Claude Monet and Camille Pissarro, Mary Cassatt was at the heart of the 19th-century movement that emerged in France and revolutionised art.

She was also a woman and foreign – “American, American through and through” is how she described herself. As a result, in the 100 years since her death, Cassatt has been frequently overlooked in the country where she produced her best work.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí rostoucímu tlaku ohledně potenciálního diplomatického urovnání války na Ukrajině, kde se objevují návrhy na teritoriální ústupky výměnou za členství v NATO. Zároveň pokračují vnitřní sociální a politické třenice ve významných státech, jako je Francie, kde probíhají rozsáhlé studentské protesty a politické napětí.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating pressure regarding a potential diplomatic settlement for the war in Ukraine, marked by floated proposals for territorial concessions in exchange for NATO membership. Concurrently, internal social and political friction persists in key member states like France amid widespread student protests and political tension.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další vyjednávání o ukrajinském mírovém rámci a reakce evropských vlád na globální diplomatické iniciativy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further negotiations on the Ukrainian peace framework and European government responses to global diplomatic initiatives are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí roste v souvislosti s obrysy potenciálních územních výměn na Ukrajině výměnou za členství v NATO a hrozícími globálními summity velmocí. Evropské trhy a politiku zatěžují také vnitřní protesty, napjaté rozpočtové debaty EU a rekordní regulatorní pokuty pro technologické giganty.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions are rising amid discussions of potential territorial trade-offs for NATO membership in Ukraine and impending high-level global summits. European markets and politics are also burdened by domestic protests, tight EU budgetary debates, and record-high regulatory fines for tech giants.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává stupňující se diplomatický tlak ohledně mírového rámce pro Ukrajinu a reakce na rostoucí sociální nepokoje ve Francii a střední Evropě.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, escalating diplomatic pressure regarding Ukraine's peace framework and government responses to mounting social unrest in France and Central Europe are expected.
